# CANDIDATE: PDH_RETEST_RSI_BOUNCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A retest of the prior day's high accompanied by an oversold RSI and bullish candle signals a mean-reversion long opportunity. This edge exists because price often reverts to the mean after an overextended move, and the combination of PDH retest, RSI<30, and bullish candle indicates short-term exhaustion and buying pressure.

## Mechanism

When price reaches the prior day's high (PDH) within the first 60 minutes of the session, RSI(14) is below 30, and the bar forms a bullish engulfing or hammer candle closing above its open, enter long at the close of that bar. Stop loss is placed just below the prior day's low (PDL); target is set at 2× initial risk; optionally trail with a 10% ATR-based stop after 1× risk is achieved.
